_comment: Official listing pages the monitor reads every morning and compares with the previous day's snapshot. New entries become candidates and go through the same verification as everything else. The first visit to a page records a baseline and reports nothing. 'default_type' is the classification used when the entry's title does not say otherwise; 'jurisdiction' is written into the summary. A page's domain must be in sources.json allowed_domains. Set 'enabled': false to pause a page without deleting it.
